name: Jigsaw: Make your PCB boards click together
tagline: Describe a circuit board and get compatible, in-stock parts instead of weeks of datasheet reading.

awards: Best Business + Enterprise Hack [Courtesy of Orcava AI, Eragon AI]

problem: Finding compatible PCB parts and buying them before stock runs out takes hardware students months.
solution: A compatibility tool that turns a board description into a parts list checked against compatibility and availability.
demo_moment: Team-described: describe a board and get a matched bill of materials.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Business + Enterprise Hack [Courtesy of Orcava AI, Eragon AI]” among 195 submissions.
Built from friends' real complaints in student engineering teams.

lessons: Interview the people complaining near you; their pain is a business brief.
